reasons.refund_claim_supported: Delivery signature is an unverifiable 'neighbour' name matching no resident and the carrier GPS fix is 140 m from the address, so the delivered status does not evidence receipt by the customer.
reasons.claim_handling: Order value 640 USD exceeds the 500 USD cap, so the 'must' constraint requires a carrier investigation before any refund; reversible, conditional steps dominate over paying or declining now.
reasons.fraud_risk: Evidence leans genuine, but two prior claims refunded without investigation, an unlogged camera outage and an unanswered manager add doubt without being proof of fraud per the 'must_not' constraint.
